batting.name: M Vijay
batting.dismissal: c Shakib Al Hasan b R Bhatia

batting.name: SK Raina
batting.dismissal: c B Lee b Shakib Al Hasan

batting.name: MS Bisla
batting.dismissal: c S Badrinath b JA Morkel

batting.name: JH Kallis
batting.dismissal: c RA Jadeja b BW Hilfenhaus

batting.name: LR Shukla
batting.dismissal: c MEK Hussey b DJ Bravo

batting.name: YK Pathan
batting.dismissal: c S Badrinath b R Ashwin

balls.text: Raina is dismissed off the final ball, Lee runs in from deep midwicket and catches the slog-swept ball low with a forward dive, he gets up and throws the ball away, but the damage has been done for KKR, too much of it
punches a full one down to long off, and again, they concede a second run, Bisla cannot collect the throw on the bounce, it was wide as well, of the stumps
pushes it to sweeper cover, fumble from the fielder, Tiwary it is, and they get another, Gambhir shakes his head
swipes a full ball on leg to deep square, Dhoni wanted the second
slog-sweep comes out, but mistimed to deep square this time
almost in the blockhole, but helicoptered along the ground to long on
floated up wide across the batsman, and called one
swiped through midwicket for a couple
take that, no one is stopping CSK today, not even Narine, Raina seemed to pick the offbreak up as he charged out and lofted it cleanly down the ground

slog-sweep that stayed in the air for an age, wonder why there was no one beneath it when it came down just inside the deep midwicket rope, but Iqbal has done quite well to slap the ball back in on the bounce into the field, there was another man backing up
swings at a length ball from the crease, turns in a bit, in the air down to short third
carrom ball, Dhoni has a go at it from the crease, under edge, could have rolled onto the stumps, didn;t
pulled to deep square, Dhoni was gearing up for the second, but slipped as he turned back
thick edge runs past short third man, Kallis followed Dhoni as he backed away to a back of a length ball, he opened the face a bit but don't think he intended to place it so fine
he is away, Dhoni gets four through square leg, short of a length ball, waist height, Dhoni swings it away easily
very low full toss on off, pushed wide of sweeper cover
punches a back of a length ball to sweeper cover with those quick hands
Kallis gets one for KKR, a tired Hussey departs after having made a huge contribution and having run 300 miles, a swipe misses and the length ball finds the stumps
even luck deserting KKR now, after the momentum did long ago, Raina exposes all the stumps and has a go at a Narine offbreak, inside edge eludes leg stump, by an inch
he is making Hussey run harder, comes down the track, mishits the offbreak over cover, Hussey has just made it as the throw comes to the bowler
flatter now instantly, and swept wide of deep square

and that is the final confirmation of CSK's dominance today, a Narine tossed up ball has been slaughtered miles and miles over deep midwicket, the Raina slog-sweep, working smoothly, fifty up for him as well
full toss now, he sweeps awkwardly behind square
opens up outside leg, the offbreak spins away slightly on middle, he whips it down to long on
inside edges a very full one down to short fine
tries to dab a widish ball after making room outside leg, cannot reach out to it though
for once, Lee gets it right tonight, yorker just outside leg stump, Raina misses it and almost falls over
still shorter from Lee, he hops in the crease and tucks it through square, and they have run two once again
this is CSK's night now, more and more, Raina is heaving without a care in the world, staying in the crease and smacking a short of a length ball just over the deep midwicket rope
it was there to be hit, he had made room to a widish full toss, but guided it straight to point, that was four had it been wide of that man
too short, that should have gone, suddenly he does not seem as big a threat, Raina does not connect with the pull though
another offbreak, tossed up and spinning away from middle, he waits on it and steers to short third
whips a tossed up ball on leg through midwicket
offbreak spinning across Raina, but he has timed it so well past short third man from the crease, it has teased the fielder all the way to the rope
shortish, pulled to deep midwicket
punched down the ground
punched to sweeper cover to keep strike

offspinner was supposed to pose some challenge to two left-handers, at least that is what the thinking would have been, but Raina is taking Yusuf apart, poor ball too, angled down the pads, and he awkwardly gets down to sweep past short fine
YK drops it short, and Raina thumps it over his hitting zone, deep midwicket
neatly done, down the track, and chipped over the bowler, it is placed so straight that long on running across fails to stop it by some margin
moves back and works gently through square leg for one, the Chepauk crowd applauds for their opener, another fifty for him, big match player, all the way
makes room outside leg, and pushes a full one around leg to long off
tries to dab it fine but finds no timing at all, to short third
punched through extra cover, and Hussey runs two again, Raina is fast as always, it was hit into the gap between sweeper cover and long off
poor line down the pads, but he does not suffer much, YK Pathan lumbers after it from fine leg and stops it
makes room outside leg, but pushes the offspinner on leg straight to extra cover

still slower from Bhatia, but they have done very well to take two with a soft tuck towards vacant midwicket, the man in the deep had too much space to cover, but that is some running from CSK in the humidity
pushes a length ball to the bowler
Kallis persists with the short ball, this is directed even better, and we have the hook from Raina, he hasn't played the stroke too badly this IPL, this one is very well controlled, down to fine leg
and we have the Raina heave over midwicket, all is well with CSK, Raina has taken on a shortish delivery just outside off and walloped it high into the crowd over deep midwicket
ending on middle from a good length, Raina is shuffling across in his crease, and fails to work it square, it rolls towards the bowler
worked through square leg for one

that has been willed past point with smart wrists from Hussey, Kallis trying the offcutter from back of a length, Hussey did not have too much width, but he got the placement right, guiding it past a diving point
shortish, pulled away to deep square leg
worked wide of deep square and they turn back for the second, make it quite safely in the end, a better throw to Bhatia would have made it tight, surely
there was some width, but Hussey has bashed that straight to extra cover
thick outside edge now as Raina pushes at an offcutter leaving him outside off, away to short third
the offcutter from Bhatia on a length on leg, moving across to middle, tucked in front of square leg

slower one and what a catch! That was slogged away, wanted to go over deep square-leg, he does not get it in the middle, it was to the left of Shakib and he dived to catch that one, a bit of a send-off as well from the bowler!
on the off, short of length, driven to long-on for a single
and now Vijay attemps a cheeky shot, walks to the off side and wants to scoop it over short fine-leg, misses, outside the leg stump but not called a wide on account of that movement to the off
top-edge and over the wicket-keeper, again, giving himself room and wanting to slog it away, gets an edge and it almost beats the short fine-leg fielder, Bhatia who had run back
moves away to outside the leg stump, wanted to cut it away, but misses the outside edge, through to the keeper
on the leg stump, gets a bit of an outside edge, pushed away to off side
slog attempted again, he wanted to go over mid-wicket, but the inside edge goes to the fielder but not for a run, which is a bit of a rarity
on the middle stump, gets on to the front foot and punches it to long-on for a single
slogged away to the deep square-leg for a four, it was pitched on the length and he wanted to hit it over mid-wicket, gets an inside edge through to the fence!
on the off stump, rolling his fingers over and driven through the covers for a single
quicker one from Bhatia, fuller as well and Vijay casually drives it through the off side by opening the face of the bat through point for a four
slogged away over to long-on yet again, it travels quickly to the fielder and Shakib has to run to his left to stop it by which time they get a couple
short ball, off-spinning slower one as well, pulled away to deep square-leg for a single
outside the off stump, Vijay wants to crash it over mid-wicket, gets bit of an inside edge through to deep mid-wicket for a single
slower one, on the off stump, neatly rolls his wrists to long-on for a single
short of length, flicked away to the leg side to mid-wicket
another no-ball and this time it is for the height, bouncer attempted, this is above shoulder and the second one for the over
slower on the off stump, Hussey slogs it over mid-wicket, does not get any timing on it and straight to the fielder
bouncer and too high, Hussey, for that fleeting moment wanted to go for the pull before pulling out and both umpires had their arms out
short of length, on the middle stump, nudged to the square-leg for a single
on the pads, flicked away to fine-leg and they are able to run away for a single
outside the off stump, short of length, not too quick at sub-130 km/hr pace, driven to mid-off
on the pads, short of length, pushed back to the bowler
fuller on the off stump, down the wicket and drilled through the covers, easy couple of runs
shimmy down the track and hit through the region between long-on and mid-wicket for another four, they are not holding back now
short of length, goes on to the back foot and creams it through the off side, straight to extra-cover, where there is a misfield and they are able to rush back for the second
on the middle stump, driven to long-on for a single
reverse sweep attempted again, but to the third man within the circle, no run yet again
pitched right up to the bat and easily pushed away to mid-off for a single

couple of steps and six! This was always going to be an interesting move, bringing Lee back and he has been taken to the cleaners now, goes down the pitch to a ball outside off and hits over the mid-off fielder for a six
pitched right up to the bat, on his pads, opens his stance and flicks it away to mid-wicket for a single
flicked mis-hit over short fine-leg for a four, it was not as quick a bouncer as Vijay originally thought and he checked the stroke, still goes over the fielder
way down the leg side and it is not called a wide, but Chennai fans, fret not, it is a no-ball, he had over-stepped there! So a Free Hit for the man who has been hitting well last one game or so...
attempts another one, this time it was not as quick and it was shorter as well, 126.9 km/hr, wants to pull it away, misses
short of length and slapped over the bowler's head for a six! Gives himself room, moves to the leg stump and times it rather well, it was not a slow ball either at 142.5 km/hr
pitched fuller on his pads, takes the full toss and drives to leg side for a single
shorter from Narine, goes on to his back foot, wants to cut it away, but goes to the covers fielder
on the front foot, pushes it to the mid-wicket region, they take a single and are able to just about come back for the second, had that hit direct at the striker's end, could just have been close
outside the off stump, on the front foot, wants to drive it, spins into the batsman and misses the inside edge
on his pads, flicked away to short fine-leg for a single, the fielder was very fine but right on the circle.
on the off stump, turning away slightly, pushed off the back foot to the covers
down the track and slammed away to wide long-on for a couple, it was pitched up and Vijay wanted to go over, beat the mid-on fielder but the deep mid-wicket fielder is able to run across and stop it
on the off stump, short to Hussey again, easily nudges it away to the leg side for a single
short of length and it has been knocked away through that very region where the mid-wicket fielder was, they run rather well to come back for the second and easily at that
and now comes the reverse sweep and beats the short third-man too, for four. That was the third such attempt at reverse sweep, third time lucky!
on the middle stump, pitched up and defended back to the bowler
top-edged but that has gone over fine-leg for six, it was round the wicket, bit shorter, and he sweeps it away over the short fine-leg fielder for a maximum
short ball and that has been tonked, almost off the front foot over mid-on for a four, 146.1 km/hr and went equally quickly!
on his pads, 143.8 km/hr, wants to flick it away, misses the shot, hits the pads and it loops up to the off side, rush off a leg-bye

short of length and he pushes it off the back foot to the left of the bowler, Lee runs towards the ball, slides and wants to throw down the stumps at the non-striker's end, all in one motion, just fumbled with the pick-up though.
on the off stump, 144.8 km/hr, short of length and he punches it to mid-off for a quick single
shimmy down the pitch and hits it over the bowler for a four, he had played 10 balls for his five and finally tastes a boundary
on the off stump, does not come on to the bat, wanted to drive it through the covers but not off the middle and it goes back to the bowler
on the middle stump, out comes the reverse sweep yet again, misses the middle of the bat, goes to backward point for a single
on the off stump, Hussey is on the back foot again and he plays it back to the bowler

shorter, quicker and pushed to the leg side, Vijay wanted to come for the single, Hussey refused because he was on the back foot, Gambhir throws it down at the non-striker's end, misses and Vijay is in
flighted up, round the stumps, driven to long-off for Vijay to get his score moving
on the middle stump, he goes on to his back foot and pushes it to deep mid-wicket for a single
round the stumps, on his pads, wants to reverse sweep but to the short third-man, did not hit it hard enough
another one short of good length, and it is pushed away to point, Tiwary dives to his right to field
short of length, on the off stump and on the back foot, he pushes it to the covers, no half volley, slow delivery to be hit first up for Vijay this game.
on the middle, slightly fuller and driven away to wide mid-on for a single, bit of an inside edge

outside the off stump and short of length, he cuts it away, almost like he rolled his wrist over the ball and through the backward point region, the third-man, Narine had to run to his right and before he can throw it back they come back for the second
outside the off stump, short of length, shoulders arms and its through to the keeper
pitched up, outside the off stump, pushed to the extra-cover fielder
KKR have won the IPL, Manoj Tiwary seals it with a pull off a short ball through square leg
Manoj Tiwary gets the boundary away, slower ball into him, and he heaves it away over square leg
he drags the low full toss from wide outside off straight to deep midwicket
direct hit and Shakib was gone easily, but square leg misses, Tiwary charging out and heaving a short ball without any timing
Shakib Al Hasan, you beauty, he gets the scoop over short fine leg away, again a full toss, Shakib was ready this time, coolly walked across, and scooped it without fuss from the stumps

Vijay celebrates after taking the catch running across from midwicket, but no-ball has been signalled, the full toss was above waist height this time, Shakib managed a top-edge, they have run two as well amid all the confusion

just got still tougher, probably even out of reach now, Hilfenhaus gets Kallis, he had to go for it, he had to go for the boundary, but he sliced a high full toss straight to sweeper cover, they check for the no-ball but bowler is alright, just about, full toss comfortably below waist height as well, a disappointed Kallis has to go
mishits this time to extra cover for a single
again Dhoni tries the backflick on to the stumps, misses, wide throw again from Jadeja, and to the non-Kallis end as well, Shakib flicking wide of deep square leg
well done, Hilfenhaus digs in the short one, a surprised Shakib lets it pass past him
there was a second to be risked there, but Kallis was settling for one, he had slammed the pitched up ball wide of sweeper cover for one, looking for the area over extra cover
tired stroke from Kallis, swings a full toss without power on the bounce to long on
opens up and whips a shortish offbreak in front of square leg
eases a flighted ball down the ground to long on and jogs across for one
flicks hard wide of deep midwicket, Jadeja releases the ball early, the throw is wide though, Dhoni tries to back-flick it onto the stumps, but misses, Kallis was struggling if the throw was better
squeezes out a tossed up full ball past point, they come back for two as sweeper cover gets to the ball

now Ashwin takes out another, Yusuf Pathan has one innings of note to show for the season, he tried to slog-sweep, looked to be the carrom ball, top-edge flies high in the air, and midwicket settles under it

Hussey almost earns CSK another wicket, what a man, on his 37th birthday, Michael Hussey leaps to hold on to a slog-sweep from Kallis at the edge of the deep midwicket rope, the momentum takes him over, he manages to let go of the ball before tumbling to the ground beyond the rope, but the ball also falls there
under pressure, Kallis gets one away, he reaches out to a wide and full slower one outside off, and lifts it to beat the two men running across from sweeper cover and long off
mishits a low full toss down to long off in the air

pressure on KKR now, slower ball as Kallis walks outside off, mistimes a push onto the leg side, there is lots of hesitation in going for the single, Bravo gets to the ball quickly and turns around midair to throw, but Kallis has made it, throw misses anyway
CSK have another wicket, the Shukla experiment has not worked, he has swung a pitched up ball straight to deep midwicket
dot ball to Shukla again, 111.8 kph slower ball cutting in from outside off, Shukla flails way outside the line
incredible stop from Suresh Raina at extra cover, that was four had he not dived full length to his right, Shukla had gone hard at the drive
Jakati gets in a dot now, Shukla charges out, sees it drifting past him full and wide and pats it to point
Kallis wanted the second run, but had to settle for one in the end after punching to sweeper cover

and he immediately goes flat and short, into the batsman with the angle, Kallis opens up and pulls dismissively on the bounce over the rope between deep midwicket and long on, coming good when his side needed him to
that will help KKR, Kallis skips out, reaches the pitch and lifts the ball straight and one bounce over the rope
appears to charge out initially, but pushes softly towards extra cover in the end for one
Shukla does what he was sent to do right away, lofts a wide and full one cleanly, but straight to sweeper cover on a couple of bounces
hits a length ball hard down to long on

Bisla is gone this time, slower one working for Morkel, 109.6 kph short ball, he tried to make room and guide it over point, but ended up getting no timing on the stroke, and point went back a few steps to take the catch, but what an innings, could be a matchwinning one
whipped to deep midwicket

direct hit and Bisla was gone, he was stranded midway, Jadeja at extra cover picked up the ball and let it go very early, would have helped probably had he waited and aimed, Kallis mistiming the drive this time, there was no run
swipes a pitched up ball down to long on, suddenly a lot more strokes are being mistimed
punches a flat length ball through extra cover for one
that was flat and wide, but Bisla mishit it straight to cover
flicks a full toss really hard now, and this time he will get only one to deep midwicket
on the pad, nudged through midwicket, and too much work for the man in the deep to do to prevent the second
smack! Kallis makes some room, bends the knee, and thumps a flat ball wide of extra cover, well wide of long off
mistimes a big drive, bowler stops it with a dive
Kallis stands calmly in the crease, allows the length ball to bounce outside off, and hangs his bat out to send it to third man
now he tries to walk across and swing over short fine, but only manages to mistime the back of a length ball tamely to square leg
stands tall in the crease and drives neatly down to long off
makes room and slams a length ball, not timed well enough, on the bounce to long off
so he stays put and runs this one past point and wide of third man, two more
comes down the pitch, without any desperation, and slaps a short of a length ball wide of sweeper cover
he reverse sweeps, again with lots of confidence, top-edge flies safely over short third
shot! Bisla is making a mess of CSK's attack, without any fuss, skips out confidently, and strikes it cleanly over extra cover
down the track, does not quite get hold of it, had Ashwin managed to deflect it on to the stumps, non-striker was gone, he managed to deflect it, just past them
whips a very full one from close to off to long on
turns a tossed up offbreak to midwicket
flighted up, defended on the front foot back to the bowler
on his pads, fuller, driven to mid-wicket for another single, asking rate's gone below nine now!
down the track, short of length this time, pushed to the long-off region for a single
outside edge and it rushes away for a four through the slips, Ashwin barely giving chase there!
down the wicket, inside-out and for four through extra covers, 100-run stand for the second wicket!
round the stumps, pitched up, nurdled through mid-wicket for a single

out, run-out? Driven back to the bowler, tremendous work by Ashwin to dive to his right and then fires it back to the keeper, who flicks the stumps, just about manages to get back to the crease does Bisla and survives
reverse sweep attempted, almost Hussey-like, misses the middle of the bat, gets a top edge and goes over the short third-man for a couple of runs, good diving stop
outside the off stump, turning in and late-opens the bat, to short third-man for a single
outside the off, driven but to the short-cover fielder
pitched up to the bat, driven through mid-wicket and they are easily able to come back for the second
tosses it up, on the middle and driven straight, the fielder at long-on ran to his left and got there, but tried to field with one hand, misfields and it goes for a four
on the off stump, fuller and Kallis drills it down the ground, on the bounce to the long-off fielder for only a single
pitched up, fuller, and wanted to drill through the mid-wicket, misses the shot and hits the pads, but down the leg side
another one for a six, it was fuller on the pads and he just used his wrists to flick it over long-on for a maximum, trouble for the bowler!
another one on the length, on the off stump, pushed to the off side for a quick one, throw came in quickly but the batsman was in
outside the off stump, short of length and punched to the deep covers for a single
fuller and and on the middle stump and that is flicked away to fine-leg for a four, the fielder was nowhere around where the stroke was played
on the pads, flicked away to the deep square-leg region for a single, bringing up a half-century for Bisla
short of length, turning away but the good thing was that it was slower, Bisla needed to wait for the ball before trying to cut it away, to the fielder
on the middle stump, short of length, nudged it to the leg side for a single
goes down the pitch and it was fired in quicker, driven on the up to long-off for a single
outside the off stump and driven through the covers for a single
outside the off stump, edged and for four through the slips, in fact finer than where the first slip would have been too!

shimmy down and six! It was a slower one, Bisla knew it was going to be outside the off stump after those two wides down the leg side, goes down and hits it over mid-off for a six! What a stroke, what a blinder from Bisla!
and this one is further down the leg side, even if he wanted to get a bat, he probably wouldn't, missed and wide called
another one down the leg side, he has been angling them in this over but this is a wide as Kallis misses it, so does Dhoni
on the leg stump again, follows him but played well, drives to long-on for a single
pitched right up to the bat, on his pads, flicked away to deep square-leg for a single
room outside the leg stump again, follows him, shorter and pulled away to deep square-leg for a single
outside the off stump,pitched up and driven to the off side, for a single
fuller and driven to mid-wicket, they don't take a run there
gives room again, wants to slash it away, he has slowed the pace down and beats the outside edge of the bat
dropped at short fine-leg, down the leg side, quicker, wanted to sweep it away, the top-edge goes almost over the fielder, Hilfy jumped high, but can only get some fingers to it, tips it over
and again, this time with a lot of aggression and over long-on for another six! This is an excellent shot again and they are taking the attack to the opposition
outside the off stump, driven to the short cover
round the stumps, goes down the track and just lifts it over the bowler, classy shot without too much effort and it's gone for a six
round the stumps, on his pads, flicked away to square-leg for a single
attempts his favourite, give-room-and-slash stroke, but is beaten by the bounce, through to the keeper
on his pads, flicked away to deep square-leg for a single, it was a typically, classy Kallis flick but there was a fielder deep
slower one from Hilfenhaus, on the middle stump, flicked away to square-leg for a single
on the middle stump, flicked away to the leg side for a single
outside the off stump, tries to punch it through the covers but the pace of the delivery makes it difficult for him to get it over, single only
short of length, on the off stump, opens the face of the bat and dabs it to the third-man for a single
down the track and cut it through the covers yet again for a four!
fuller and four, no movement from the batsman this time, outside the off stump and he leant into the shot and hits a lofted cover drive to the right of the sweeper fielder
cut away yet again after giving himself room, slices the gap and for a four, pressure on the bowler
pulled away but to the deep square-leg fielder, Ravindra Jadeja, for a single, it was a short of length and Kallis looked like he wanted to give it his all
again that movement to outside the leg side, length ball, driven to the off side and they are able to rush away for a single
down the leg side and that is a wide, two in a row now and something to cheer for KKR
short of length and wide, after that previous full-toss, he had to shorten his length but this was too short
full-toss, width and four! Goes down the track and takes the ball on the full, slashes it through point and there was no way the third-man was getting anywhere close
short of length, outside the off stump and Kallis wants to pull it away, but hits it to the mid-wicket fielder this time
fuller, outside the off stump, driven to the off side but straight to the cover fielder, nothing added to the total
short of length, on the leg stump, goes outside the leg stump and drives to mid-on for a run
bouncer but down the leg side, he is giving himself a lot of room and this time Hilfenhaus followed him and delivered it short, but down for a wide
gives room again and wants to slay it through the covers, mistimes it and goes back to the bowler, length ball that was
shorter from Hilfenhaus, was wanting to pull it away before realising it was slower, still went through with the shot and it goes over mid-wicket for a boundary
on the pads, going down probably after hitting the pads, Hilfy was the only one getting excited after it stuck him but the umpire was having none of it
short ball, wants to pull it away, misses the bottom of the bat, through to the keeper
again on a length, pushes it to the point region and they are away for a single, he dabbed it rather gently to allow them to go for the run
outside the off stump and Kallis has rocked back and with that extra room, he cuts it over point for a four
short of length, on the off stump, Kallis defends on the back foot to the off side
short of length, on the middle length and the batsman is immediately on his back foot, pushes it to the leg side for a single
outside the off stump, width for the batsman, tries to cut it away, bit of an under-edge through to the keeper, some swing away too

out, bowled, end of the captain! That was an off-spinner at 120 km/hr, it drifted into the batsman and then held its line, misses the slog and it sneaks through to it timber, the KKR camp is as quiet as the others in the stadium are not.
wide outside the off stump, goes for an expansive drive, an outside edge goes fine and for four...oh wow, Jakati dives to his right and gets it inside the field
outside the off stump, pitched on the length and he wants to drive it on the up, mistimed a little, to short cover
short of length and outside the off stump, Gambhir immediately wanted to upper cut it over point, misses the outside edge
room given by the batsman, cut away to the deep point fielder for a single
on the middle stump, pitched right up to the bat, swinging away from the batsman, the first time I have seen that tonight, defended back to the bowler.
